_drive: The test drive through the centre (4.5 km, about 98 s). Set 21 Nov 2026 at about twice the readings after the freeze-frame fix (PR #372), the smaller house-front pages and Pepleri, Delta and the Catholic school built in steps. Seven drives read: the game busy for over 0.1 s 0 times (1 before those three places were stepped), longest 65 to 85 ms, 0.3 to 0.6 s in stretches over 50 ms, 95th percentile 5 to 8 ms. The code before the fix read 12 and 19 times over 0.1 s, longest 379 and 669 ms, 3.8 and 6.4 s (desktop and phone). Gaps between frames over 0.1 s: 0 or 1 after the fix (the 1 is the software drawing process stalling, which is why the longest gap has no budget), 15 and 26 before. These replace the old desktop figure (15 frames standing at the start).
